title: People Ops lifecycle and tooling manual
author: Ava Martinez
content:
Overview

Purpose: This manual consolidates People Ops processes, role and career ladder reference points, benefits highlights, hiring/onboarding flow, and the authoritative internal tools access matrix. It is intended for hiring managers, new hires, hiring coordinators, and platform owners.

Scope: Company-wide (all full-time, part-time, and contractor employees) except where departmental exceptions are noted. This doc covers 1) pre-start hiring steps, 2) first 90 onboarding operations, 3) role and career ladder touchpoints, 4) benefits & perks quick reference, 5) internal tooling and access requests, and 6) operational SLAs and owners.

--

1) Quick summary for managers (TL;DR)

- Submit candidate offer paperwork through HRIS within 24 hours of verbal acceptance.
- Ensure equipment and primary access requests are filed at least 10 business days before start date.
- Assign a direct mentor and 90-day milestones on day 1.
- Expect typical engineering ramp: 6–10 weeks to independent feature contribution; product/customer-facing roles vary.

--

2) Pre-start (hiring coordinator checklist)

Steps (numbered):
1. Finalize offer and confirm start date in Greenhouse and HRIS.
2. Request seat and equipment via IT portal (see "Internal tools & access" section). SLA: 10 business days for workstation build; escalate to IT lead if not resolved.
3. Generate the onboarding calendar and share with manager, mentor, and hire.
4. Provision access to core systems: email, SSO, Slack, Confluence, Jira, Google Workspace, Okta. Default access bundle: Basic Employee.
5. Complete new hire paperwork: NDAs, payroll forms, benefits enrollment window documentation.

Table: Pre-start SLA summary
| Item | Owner | SLA | Escalation |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Account provisioning (SSO/email/Slack) | IT Platform | 2 business days | it-ops@redwood.ai |
| Workstation procurement | IT Hardware | 10 business days | hw-ops@redwood.ai |
| Badge & building access | Facilities | 3 business days | facilities@redwood.ai |
| Benefits enrollment instructions | People Ops | 1 business day (post-offer) | benefits@redwood.ai |

--

3) First 90 days (detailed checklist for new hires)

Week 0 (before first day):
- Confirm calendar invite for orientation, team intro, and 1:1s.
- Complete required security training (SANS security-lite module).
- Review Team Charter and OKRs.

Days 1–7:
- Orientation: Company mission, policies, and handbook walkthrough.
- Tools setup: Slack, Confluence, Jira, GitHub (repo access depends on team).
- Meet mentor and manager: agree on first 30/60/90 objectives.

Weeks 2–6:
- Deliver first small technical/non-technical contribution (bug fix, doc change, small story).
- Attend cross-functional onboarding sessions: Product, SRE, Security.
- Schedule 30-minute role-alignment check-ins every 2 weeks.

Weeks 7–12:
- Transition to independent delivery on assigned projects.
- Complete role competency self-assessment (template in Confluence).
- Manager submits formal 90-day feedback in HRIS.

Onboarding success metrics (targets):
- Time-to-first-merged-PR (engineering): median <= 21 days.
- Account provisioning SLA achievement >= 95%.
- New hire onboarding NPS >= 8 (measured at day 30 and day 90).

--

4) Role & career ladders (reference guide)

Principles: ladders are competency-based, transparent, and role-focused. They consist of four canonical dimensions: Scope, Autonomy, Impact, and Craft. Title bands are tied to compensation bands managed by People Ops and Finance.

Role ladder quick map (example for IC engineering):
- Associate Engineer (L1): learning + guided tasks.
- Engineer (L2): independent component contributions.
- Senior Engineer (L3): owns services, mentors others.
- Staff Engineer (L4): cross-team technical leadership.
- Principal/Distinguished (L5+): company-level architecture and product direction.

Career movement process (numbered):
1. Employee completes self-nomination in HRIS with evidence artifacts.
2. Manager completes calibration packet and forwards to panel.
3. Role calibration panel reviews and returns decision within 30 days.
4. If promoted, comp change effective next payroll cycle; retroactive adjustments handled per People Ops policy.

Related artifacts (links): competency maps, rubric templates, and calibration schedule. See "competency-maps-and-rotation-paths-2027" for full rubrics.

--

5) Benefits & perks (concise reference)

Highlights (short bullets):
- Health: core medical, dental, vision (provider vendor links in Benefits portal). 90-day eligibility waiting period for part-time contractors varies.
- Parental leave: primary caregiver 18 weeks, secondary caregiver 8 weeks (policy effective 2026 parental policy refresh).
- Stipends: Hybrid office stipend and annual remote-work ergonomic allowance $300 (submit receipts to expenses@redwood.ai).
- Learning & development: $2,000 annual L&D credit and 8 hours/month paid learning time.
- Sabbatical: 6-week sabbatical after 5 years tenure (application through People Ops).
- Commuter and transit benefits where available per region.

How to enroll: benefits enrollment guide link in Benefits portal. Open enrollment: November 1–15 annually; special enrollments permitted within 30 days of qualifying events.

--

6) Hiring & interview process overview (for hiring managers)

Stage checklist:
1. Requisition approval (hiring manager completes req and gets VP approval).
2. Panel design: include at least one cross-functional interviewer and one diversity-focused hiring panelist.
3. Interview scorecards: use standardized role rubric; avoid hypothetical brainteasers.
4. Offer calibration: work with People Ops on comp bands and sign-off.
5. Post-offer: complete reference checks and background checks (as relevant by region).

Diversity & inclusion note: all roles must include a D&I-aware interviewer where possible; anonymized resume review recommended for initial screening.

--

7) Internal tools & access (authoritative matrix + request templates)

Default Access Bundles (short descriptions):
- Basic Employee: email, Slack, Confluence read, Google Workspace.
- Eng Contributor: Basic + GitHub repo access (team repos), CI/CD dashboard, dev cluster read.
- Manager Bundle: Basic + People Ops management console, compensation view.
- Contractor: Basic + limited-contrib GitHub; access expiry enforced by HRIS.

Access request SLA: Most SSO/SaaS accounts: 2 business days. Elevated privileges (admin, prod deploy keys): approval required from team lead + security, SLA 5 business days.

Tooling table (representative):
| Tool | Default owner | Default bundle | Request method |
|---|---|---|---|
| Okta | IT Platform | Basic Employee | okta-request@redwood.ai (ticket) |
| GitHub | Eng Platform | Eng Contributor | github-request form (Confluence) |
| Datadog | Observability Team | Read-only | datadog-requests@redwood.ai |
| GCP Console | Cloud Infra | Scoped roles | gcp-access form (requires billing owner signoff) |

Request templates (copy & paste):
- Subject: Access request — [Tool] — [Full Name] — [Team]
- Body: Full name, start date, job title, requested bundle, business justification, manager approval email.

Security & compliance: All access to production systems must use MFA; service accounts require key rotation policy applied (see security-and-compliance/procurement-and-secrets). Audit logs are retained per data-residency policies.

--

8) Operational SLAs and owner contacts

SLA highlights:
- New hire core account provisioning: 95% within 2 business days.
- Laptop delivery: 90% within 10 business days.
- Badge provisioning: 95% within 3 business days.
- Benefits enrollment assistance: 1 business day response from People Ops.

Owner/contact matrix (short):
- People Ops general: people-ops@redwood.ai
- IT Platform: it-platform@redwood.ai
- Hardware: hw-ops@redwood.ai
- Facilities: facilities@redwood.ai
- Benefits: benefits@redwood.ai

--

9) Templates & sample artifacts

Sample 30/60/90 objective template (bullet list):
- 30 days: complete onboarding curriculum, merge first doc/PR.
- 60 days: ship a scoped ticket with peer review.
- 90 days: independently own a feature or customer deliverable.

Account request example (copyable):
Subject: Access request — GitHub — Jane Doe — Eng Platform
Body:
Name: Jane Doe
Start date: 2028-04-01
Role: Software Engineer II
Bundle: Eng Contributor
Repos needed: infra/common, runtime/serving
Manager approval: manager@example.com
Justification: Required for repo onboarding and first sprint deliverables.

Performance calibration packet checklist:
- Self-nomination form (HRIS export)
- 3–5 artifacts showing impact (PRs, design docs, customer feedback)
- Manager assessment and proposed band change

--

10) Continuous improvement & metrics

Quarterly review items owned by People Ops:
- Ramp-time metrics and first-PR median. Goal: reduce median by 10% annually.
- Onboarding NPS and qualitative feedback themes.
- Access-provisioning SLA adherence.
- Promotion velocity and calibration variance.

Feedback loop: managers, new hires, and platform owners must file retrospectives into Confluence page "onboarding-retrospectives" after each hiring wave. People Ops will run a quarterly synthesis and propose improvements.

--

Appendix A: Exceptions & regional notes

- APAC: benefits and tax paperwork vary by country; local HR partners must be engaged during offer.
- Europe: background checks are consent-based; GDPR-compliant data handling must be observed.

Appendix B: Revision history

- 2028-02-15: Created by Ava Martinez.
